result.instructions: Tools for Keap, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Keap data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run keap_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run keap_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run keap_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. keap_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: keap_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts in the Keap CRM. Supports filtering, ordering, field selection, and cursor pagination (page_size / page_token). Keap: GET /contacts.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response's next_page_token.

filter.description: Filter expression, e.g. `given_name==John` (see Keap REST v2 filtering).

order_by.description: Field to order results by, e.g. `given_name` or `-date_created`.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return (field selection).

tools.name: keap_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by id. Keap: GET /contacts/{contact_id}.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return (field selection).

tools.name: keap_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: CREATE a new contact in the Keap CRM. Provide any of given_name, family_name, email_addresses, phone_numbers, company_id, plus an optional `extra` object of any other Keap fields. Keap: POST /contacts.

email_addresses.description: Email addresses to set on the contact.

field.description: Which email slot, e.g. EMAIL1 / EMAIL2 / EMAIL3.

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers to set on the contact.

field.description: Which phone slot, e.g. PHONE1 / PHONE2.

company_id.description: Id of the company to associate the contact with.

extra.description: Any other Keap fields to merge into the request body verbatim.

tools.name: keap_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: UPDATE an existing contact by id. Provide any of given_name, family_name, email_addresses, phone_numbers, company_id, plus an optional `extra` object of any other Keap fields (only supplied fields are changed). Keap: PATCH /contacts/{contact_id}.

email_addresses.description: Email addresses to set on the contact.

field.description: Which email slot, e.g. EMAIL1 / EMAIL2 / EMAIL3.

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers to set on the contact.

field.description: Which phone slot, e.g. PHONE1 / PHONE2.

company_id.description: Id of the company to associate the contact with.

extra.description: Any other Keap fields to merge into the request body verbatim.

tools.name: keap_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: CREATE a task (follow-up / to-do), optionally linked to a contact. Keap: POST /tasks.

description.description: A longer description / notes for the task.

contact_id.description: Id of a contact to link the task to.

extra.description: Any other Keap fields to merge into the request body verbatim.

tools.name: keap_apply_tag
tools.title: Apply tag to contacts
tools.description: APPLY a tag to one or more contacts (segments them / can trigger automation). Keap: POST /tags/{tag_id}/contacts:applyTags.

tag_id.description: The id of the tag to apply.

contact_ids.description: Ids of the contacts to tag.
